method: Specific-S dagger: learned selective expert routing on disagreement cases.
source_calibration: Full existing source calibration plus32 target calibration; no validation/test fitting
reference_probabilities: 5fold OOF Shared and crossfitted calibrated expert on fitting-calibration rows
selector: Weighted L2 logistic classifier of expert correctness on binary-disagreement calibration rows; standardized centered scores and confidence features
budget_selection: Rank by estimated expert win probability among disagreements, no labels needed at prediction time; top floor.045*N at most.
accuracy_bound: At most4.5percent labels change, so absolute accuracy difference cannot exceed4.5percentage points. Lower bound not guaranteed.
selection: Development accuracy only, Shared fallback. No test-driven filtering.
auxiliary_training_and_data: All experts frozen from earlier development; no new clinical labels or expert fitting
domain_metadata: Known domains as in v18, equally available to all methods
